نتنافر (form VI)
# نَتَنَافَرُ (natanāfaru) /na.ta.naː.fa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَافَرَ (tanāfara)
# نَتَنَافَرَ (natanāfara) /na.ta.naː.fa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَافَرَ (tanāfara)
# نَتَنَافَرْ (natanāfar) /na.ta.naː.far/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَافَرَ (tanāfara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
